name: Pennant Feature Flags
note: Ordered targeting rules evaluate exactly like the SDK would: individual targets, then rules top to bottom, then a percentage fallthrough bucketed by a stable hash of flag and user key, and the evaluator lights the rule that matched. Rules reorder with Alt+arrows under a FLIP, rollout splits animate through a registered percentage, and edits stage as a reviewable change set with an audit log.
